title: PRISM: Perspective Reasoning for Integrated Synthesis and Mediation as a Multi-Perspective Framework for AI Alignment
reasoning: The paper develops an AI alignment framework called PRISM that is grounded in moral psychology and ethical theory. It explicitly incorporates and evaluates moral reasoning through various lenses, including major Western ethical traditions (utilitarianism, deontology, virtue ethics) and Eastern philosophical/religious traditions (Confucianism, Daoism, and Buddhism).
